answers.8:
sed -i '1i global\n    log stdout format raw local0 info' /tmp/haproxy.cfg
sed -i 's/^    mode http/    mode http\n    log global\n    option httplog/' /tmp/haproxy.cfg
nohup haproxy -f /tmp/haproxy.cfg > /tmp/hp.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1
for i in 1 2 3; do curl -s localhost:8080/x >/dev/null; done
sleep 1
grep -c GET /tmp/hp.log > /tmp/cnt.txt

# 로그 한 줄에서 frontend, backend/server, 타이밍, 상태 코드, 요청 줄을 읽을 수 있다
answers.9:
sed -i 's/^    default_backend app/    acl is_admin path_beg \/admin\n    http-request deny deny_status 403 if is_admin\n    default_backend app/' /tmp/haproxy.cfg
haproxy -D -f /tmp/haproxy.cfg
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' localhost:8080/admin/login > /tmp/admin.txt
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' localhost:8080/ > /tmp/root.txt

# path_beg : 경로가 해당 문자열로 시작한다
answers.10:
sed -i 's/^    default_backend app/    stick-table type ip size 1m expire 10s store http_req_rate(10s)
    http-request track-sc0 src
    acl too_fast sc_http_req_rate(0) gt 3
    http-request deny deny_status 429 if too_fast
    default_backend app/' /tmp/haproxy.cfg
haproxy -D -f /tmp/haproxy.cfg
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}
' localhost:8080/; done > /tmp/codes.txt
